description: Creates a free online poll on Tickmi and returns a link participants open on their phones to vote, plus a private manage link with live results and a big-screen view. Use when the user wants a quick vote or survey with fixed choices (2–10 options). No sign-up needed; the poll is deleted 30 days after the last edit. Example: "Make a poll: which dish for the year-end party? Hotpot, BBQ, Seafood".

language.description: Language of the page shown to participants: vi (Vietnamese) or en (English).

max_choices.description: How many options each person may pick. Default 1.

name: create_poll

expires_at.description: ISO time when the tool is deleted if not edited again.

manage_url.description: Private link for the creator to see results and edit. Keep it secret.

studio_import_url.description: invite only: opens Tickmi Studio to turn the card into an event with RSVP and QR check-in.

view_url.description: Link to share with participants (or to open the tool).

title: Create an online poll
